# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## cand_0002 (pending RESULT)
- Copyable flight numbers in docstring examples (HAT001/HAT002, HAT101/HAT202) were literally reused by the agent as flight numbers in cabin upgrades (44). Use placeholders in every example.
- The env accepts ANY existing flight in update_reservation_flights / book_reservation, so off-route or invented flights silently corrupt the DB. Route validation must happen in the wrapper.
- tau2 reservation ids are assigned sequentially: when several reservations are booked, booking ORDER decides the DB match (23 t4 had all correct args but in the wrong order).

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## cand_0003 (pending RESULT)
- Parallel tool calls from one assistant turn run in an unpredictable order in the blackbox proxy. Several writes whose order matters (sequential reservation ids) need a composite tool that loops in a fixed order. A docstring "book in this order" rule did not help (23 under cand_0002: order was right in the text, wrong in execution).
- A cancel guard that counts "has insurance" as a ground lets change-of-plans cancels through (44). The reason must be an argument of a tool. Gold task 39 cancels an insurance-only reservation for a non-health reason, so a strict "health/weather only" allowlist would break it. Use a denylist of explicit uncovered reasons.
- tau2 gold reads "flights of N hours or less (including layovers)" per flight (44 upgrades KC18K6: 3h + 2h legs, 7h door to door).
- The policy table "membership × cabin" free bag allowance matches all 10 gold bookings, so a correcting computation is safe.
